draft.shortGloss: to live; to stay; to remain
draft.emotion: grounded and steady, as if describing a place that feels like home
notes: Its stem रह (with है/था) forms the continuous tense of other verbs (जैसे: वह सो रहा है, 'he is sleeping').
After a participle (-ता/-ती/-ते), it means 'to keep doing' something (वह बोलता रहता है, 'he keeps talking').
Do not confuse with ठहरना, which specifically means to stay temporarily (such as at a hotel).
